title: Incremental Yandex review sync erased replies and triggered an unlimited paid fallback
original_report: The scheduled review parser processed companies outside the requested list, downloaded complete review histories through Apify, and a native delta refresh erased stored owner replies.
discovery_scope: production automation settings and queue evidence
expected: A delta refresh preserves existing replies and any paid fallback is bounded and applied incrementally.
actual: Empty native reply fields overwrote stored replies, while native failure started an unlimited full-history Apify run.
environment: Python 3.11 in an ephemeral production-image Docker container; PostgreSQL production verification
reproduction: Focused tests simulated an empty reply in an existing review and a native proxy failure before the Apify fallback.
failure_signal: Both focused tests failed before the fix for the predicted causal reason.
root_cause: The delta UPSERT assigned EXCLUDED.response_text unconditionally. The reviews_delta fallback omitted max_reviews and used apply_complete_review_snapshot.
fix_summary: Preserve stored reply fields when an incoming delta has no reply; cap reviews_delta Apify fallback at 50 and persist it through the delta UPSERT. Explicit reviews_full behavior remains unchanged.
why_causal: The changed UPSERT controls the destructive overwrite directly, and the worker branch now supplies the paid Actor limit and avoids complete-snapshot replacement for scheduled deltas.

Regression test for a bounded incremental Apify fallback.

fix_files.summary: Accept normalized fallback IDs and preserve stored replies during delta UPSERT.

limitations: The paid fallback intentionally reads at most 50 newest reviews per run.
residual_risks: More than 50 new reviews between runs require a later run to catch the remainder.
Riderra, Transfer Ofis and HighSpeed and Go currently lack supported Yandex map cards and remain outside this Yandex schedule.
notes: No new Apify Actor run was used for the native card refresh or the reply restoration.
Explicit reviews_full remains available for intentionally requested complete snapshots.
